judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Skills Objectives (same statement-type grain) in Geometry shape units: the first (P1, rank 0, Unit 11 'Right angle, Square, and Rectangle') has pupils explore concrete rectangular and square objects in the school environment; the second (P2, rank 1, Unit 11 'Square, rectangle, and triangle') has pupils distinguish a square, rectangle and triangle from other geometrical shapes. Direction is lower-to-higher rank (P1 to P2) and permitted. Familiarity with square and rectangle exemplars from the environment plausibly supports success in the later discrimination task. Evidence limitation: both endpoints' source evidence is truncated (24 omitted items each) and all endpoints/ancestors carry upstream audit/merge context, so the judgment rests on the bounded visible statement text, LCs, and resolved Grade coordinates.
